import html # Example HTML template containing a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Content
{user_content}
""" def create_html_output(input_text: str) -> str: """ Safely embed user-provided text into an HTML template. Parameters ---------- input_text : str Raw content supplied by the user that will be inserted into the HTML. Returns ------- str The final HTML string with user content escaped to prevent XSS or malformed markup. """ # Escape special characters to avoid breaking the HTML structure and mitigate XSS. safe_content = html.escape(input_text, quote=True) # Format the template with the escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
